title: Target Expands Next-Day Delivery Across the U.S.
summary: Learn more about next-day delivery from Target.
body_markdown:
Over 60% of the U.S. population has access to quicker, easier shopping as Target expands next-day delivery of online orders to more markets. Guests in more than 50 top U.S. metro areas will be able to get their purchases delivered next day — in many cases for free. It's yet another option among Target’s[fulfillment offerings](https://www.target.com/c/shipping-order-services/-/N-551st) , which also includes guest-favorite same-day services and two-day shipping.


Most items eligible for shipping at Target are eligible for next-day delivery. That includes hundreds of thousands of items — 85% of what we sell in Target stores. (Check an item’s product detail page, or the cart and checkout page, for next-day delivery eligibility and order-by time.)


Next-day delivery is free for orders over $35 or with no minimum order amount if you're a[Target Circle 360](https://www.target.com/l/target-circle-360/-/N-2rguk) member or use your[Target Circle Card](https://www.target.com/circlecard) for purchases.


This is just one of the ways Target offers a convenient digital shopping experience. We already reach 80% of the U.S. population with same-day delivery — often within two or three hours — and 99% with two-day shipping. And our Order Pickup and Drive Up services are always free and available for guests on their timeline.
